snippet.title: Dynasty Warriors: Origins - Visions of Four Heroes Overview Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/JP0106-PPSA15972_00-DWORIGINSGAME000

New stories with the Four Heroes begins! DYNASTY WARRIORS: ORIGINS Vision of Four Heroes launches January 22nd on PlayStation®5.
 
This major paid DLC adds new stories featuring the Four Heroes, new allies, weapons, and more. The immersive battlefields and exhilarating 1 vs. 1,000 action return!
